canonical_title: SK hynix breaks ground on $4B Indiana HBM packaging and AI R&D facility
aliases: SK hynix Indiana $4 billion HBM facility
SK hynix Purdue Research Park AI chip packaging
SK hynix West Lafayette HBM packaging plant
treatment: Covered at construction-groundbreaking milestone. Repeat only for cleanroom/production start, material capacity or product-generation disclosure, major customer commitment, or material financing/scope change.
known_facts: SK hynix held the groundbreaking ceremony for an advanced packaging and AI semiconductor R&D facility in West Lafayette, Indiana, with total investment now stated at more than $4 billion.
The site is planned to house a next-generation HBM packaging line and AI semiconductor R&D facility.
Cleanroom operations are scheduled for the second half of 2028.
The U.S. government previously finalized $458 million in grants and up to $500 million in loans under the CHIPS Act.
reinclude_only_if: SK hynix discloses material HBM generation, packaging capacity, or production-volume details.
The facility reaches cleanroom or production start.
A named Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, or other major customer commitment materially changes the project.
The investment, financing, or facility scope materially changes.
notes: The ceremony occurred in the night window. The project was announced earlier, but groundbreaking is a new construction milestone.
